t: What Environmental Remediation Database Is All About
title: What Environmental Remediation Database Is All About
description: Remediation cleans contaminated sites: dig-and-haul (fast, expensive), pump-and-treat (decades for groundwater), bioremediation (microbes eat oil — Exxon Valdez shorelines), phytoremediation (plants pull metals). Superfund lists 1,300+ US sites; Love Canal (1978) created the program. Match the method to contaminant and geology — verified by monitoring, not promises.
